agent_fact_requests_held_has_approval_ck.name: agent_fact_requests_held_has_approval_ck
agent_fact_requests_held_has_approval_ck.value: "agent_fact_requests"."status" <> 'held' or ("agent_fact_requests"."held_answer" is not null and "agent_fact_requests"."filter_approval_id" is not null)

deliverable_facts_source_shape_ck.name: deliverable_facts_source_shape_ck
deliverable_facts_source_shape_ck.value: ("deliverable_facts"."source_type" = 'system') = ("deliverable_facts"."connector_provider" is not null and "deliverable_facts"."connector_config" is not null)

deliverable_runs_checked_has_verdict_ck.name: deliverable_runs_checked_has_verdict_ck
deliverable_runs_checked_has_verdict_ck.value:
"deliverable_runs"."status" not in ('checked', 'awaiting_approval', 'approved', 'shipped')
          or ("deliverable_runs"."checked_at" is not null and "deliverable_runs"."check_outcome" is not null and "deliverable_runs"."check_draft_hash" is not null)

deliverable_runs_sequential_approval_ck.name: deliverable_runs_sequential_approval_ck
deliverable_runs_sequential_approval_ck.value: "deliverable_runs"."second_approval_id" is null or "deliverable_runs"."first_approved_at" is not null

deliverable_runs_both_approvals_to_ship_.name: deliverable_runs_both_approvals_to_ship_ck
deliverable_runs_both_approvals_to_ship_.value:
"deliverable_runs"."status" not in ('approved', 'shipped')
          or ("deliverable_runs"."first_approval_id" is not null and "deliverable_runs"."first_approved_at" is not null
              and "deliverable_runs"."second_approval_id" is not null and "deliverable_runs"."second_approved_at" is not null)

fact_values_provenance_ck.name: fact_values_provenance_ck
fact_values_provenance_ck.value:
"fact_values"."status" not in ('fetched', 'answered')
          or ("fact_values"."source_ref" is not null and "fact_values"."method" is not null and "fact_values"."fetched_at" is not null)

human_action_handles_target_check.name: human_action_handles_target_check
human_action_handles_target_check.value: ("human_action_handles"."target_kind" = 'company' AND "human_action_handles"."company_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("human_action_handles"."target_kind" IN ('self', 'instance', 'public') AND "human_action_handles"."company_id" IS NULL)

issues_open_routine_execution_uq.name: issues_open_routine_execution_uq
issues_open_routine_execution_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'routine_execution'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."execution_run_id" is not null
          and "issues"."status" in ('backlog', 'todo', 'in_progress', 'in_review', 'blocked')

issues_active_liveness_recovery_incident.name: issues_active_liveness_recovery_incident_uq
issues_active_liveness_recovery_incident.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'harness_liveness_escalation'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled')

issues_active_liveness_recovery_leaf_uq.name: issues_active_liveness_recovery_leaf_uq
issues_active_liveness_recovery_leaf_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'harness_liveness_escalation'
          and "issues"."origin_fingerprint" <> 'default'
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled')

issues_active_stale_run_evaluation_uq.name: issues_active_stale_run_evaluation_uq
issues_active_stale_run_evaluation_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'stale_active_run_evaluation'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled')

issues_active_productivity_review_uq.name: issues_active_productivity_review_uq
issues_active_productivity_review_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'issue_productivity_review'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled')

issues_active_stranded_issue_recovery_uq.name: issues_active_stranded_issue_recovery_uq
issues_active_stranded_issue_recovery_uq.where:
"issues"."origin_kind" = 'stranded_issue_recovery'
          and "issues"."origin_id" is not null
          and "issues"."hidden_at" is null
          and "issues"."status" not in ('done', 'cancelled')

verdicts_entity_target_check.name: verdicts_entity_target_check
verdicts_entity_target_check.value:
(
        ("verdicts"."entity_type" = 'goal' and "verdicts"."goal_id" is not null and "verdicts"."project_id" is null and "verdicts"."issue_id" is null)
        or ("verdicts"."entity_type" = 'project' and "verdicts"."project_id" is not null and "verdicts"."goal_id" is null and "verdicts"."issue_id" is null)
        or ("verdicts"."entity_type" = 'issue' and "verdicts"."issue_id" is not null and "verdicts"."goal_id" is null and "verdicts"."project_id" is null)
      )

verdicts_reviewer_xor_check.name: verdicts_reviewer_xor_check
verdicts_reviewer_xor_check.value: ("verdicts"."reviewer_agent_id" is not null) <> ("verdicts"."reviewer_user_id" is not null)
